name: Mekong giant catfish
desc: One of the largest freshwater fish; after its first year it mostly feeds on algae. Found in the Tonlé Sap, but now rare.
about: The Mekong giant catfish is a large species of catfish (order Siluriformes) in the shark catfish family (Pangasiidae), native to the Mekong basin in Southeast Asia and adjacent China.
